findings.observation: Finding Oki displays level 4, Adventuring, Tanvu and Kojan. The Details field lists Old Man Kanjaro as starter and location -38307, -45570, 1686. No Hand in to field or reward section is displayed. Missing fields remain unknown.

The primary objective is Search for Oki. The summary describes Oki as another student of Jin and places his hut along the beach east of Dallerjuba. Notes say Examine corspe at location -22262, -44361, 231, preserving the source spelling. This note coordinate is separate from the Details location and does not establish a spawn or operative quest completion trigger.

Finding Oki Previous A Humble New Beginning agrees with that cached page Next Finding Oki. Finding Oki Next Avenging Oki is a displayed navigation edge; the linked followup has not been reviewed in this record. Navigation does not prove enforced prerequisites or a unique linear chain.

The Details field explicitly says Repeatable No. The retained parser-18 record leaves repeatable null, while the parser-19 record sets false from that label. These are versioned extractions of the same cached source, not conflicting historical accounts.

The Another account section repeats the recorded summary and attributes a source to the Telon Project. It is preserved separately, without treating archive transcriptions of mirrors as independent corroboration. No structured disagreement section is displayed on this page; that absence does not settle the preceding quest disagreements.
